newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - Service Corp extends offer.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - Service Corp extends offer.

text.p: Service Corp International said Friday that it extended the waiting period for its exchange offer for all outstanding shares of Loewen Group Inc .
This is the full text of the announcement.

HOUSTON, Nov. 1 /PRNewswire/ -- Service Corporation International (NYSE: SRV) (SCI) announced today that it has received a request for additional information from the Federal Trade Commission with respect to its filings under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 in connection with its US$45.00 per common share exchange offer to purchase all of the outstanding shares of The Loewen Group Inc.(NYSE: LWN) Accordingly, the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period, which was originally scheduled to expire at 11:59 p.m., New York City time, on November 2, 1996, will be extended and will now expire 20 days after substantial compliance by SCI with the request for additional information.
SCI said the second request is in line with the Company's expectations, and that it will work as expeditiously as possible to comply with the FTC's request.

Service Corporation International is the largest funeral home and cemetery organization in the world, with 2,864 funeral service locations, 335 cemeteries and 147 crematoria as of September 30, 1996. SCI provides funeral and cemetery services in North America, Europe and the Pacific Rim. SCI's stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange. The company's ticker symbol is SRV.
